Name: Custom Multiplayer Toddler
Author: HanziTM
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vhgLatW.png[/img]
Simple Content Patcher mod that allows you to change the appearance of your toddlers in multiplayer since Child to NPC framework does not work in multiplayer.
This mod allows you to change the assets of the toddler by placing your desired toddler into the assets folder and then changing the name of your file to match mine. Afterwards, you need to replace your pictures with mine. This mod was inspired by 

Eri as Toddler: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6320

and the example assets are used from

Child Age Up: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5810

 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ebgueB0.png[/img]
Step 1: Replace the files and change your name to Daisy (for girl toddler) and Zaihan (for boy toddler)﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YhQi9e5.jpg[/img]

Step 2: Enjoy! 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/URragD1.png[/img]
